Thanks Naomi / Lena. Technical notes and risk callouts below so Brightline can plan the export/ingest: 

- Retention policy: We'll create a scoped lifecycle policy ID RL-18M-540 that sets archival/expiry at 540 days (18 months). Implementation will be a config change in the retention service and a metadata migration for objects with existing TTLs. Target change date: 2025-11-26 01:00 UTC (maintenance window).
- Historical export: We'll generate an export snapshot of relevant log buckets, encrypt with customer-managed keys (if requested), and publish presigned URLs to the transfer bucket. We will also include s3-transfer-manifest.csv with object path, size bytes, and md5.
- Bandwidth / throughput: Our standard transfer throughput can saturate up to 600 Mbps for a short burst; for the 1.2 TB you should expect ~5–6 hours if fully provisioned. If Brightline needs a faster window we can temporarily increase throughput (requires a network ops booking).
- Data redaction: We will provide guidance and a redaction checklist; if you need pre-redaction we can run a redaction pass but that adds time to the delivery.

Attachments/Refs: s3-transfer-manifest.csv (will be populated), retention-config-RL-18M-540.patch (config diff).
